notes.title: MONSTERS OF KANJI / Update 1.1 / Release!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I am happy to announce that "MONSTERS OF KANJI 1.1" is now online!

In the last weeks I spent a lot of time ironing out small typos and balance problems with the game. Steam Achievements and a world map have also already been added. And now it's time for the biggest addition to the game so far:

- Inside the ANCIENT ARCHIVE there are now 109 additional pictures that point out the stroke order of a lot ot kanji. That way you can do more than just review your knowledge. You can actually learn how to write many of the kanji. Still, I want to highlight this again: MONSTERS OF KANJI is in no way a substitute for proper Japanese lessons. The focus of this game are still its story and the exploration of its giant world.

Also part of the free update 1.1:

- Script improvement
- Enemy balance improvement

Of course, your savegame won't be affected by the update.

I will keep taking care of the Community Hub and if you have any questions, feel free to ask. Other than that, I hope you keep enjoying MONSTERS OF KANJI. Thanks a lot for your support!

notes.title: Steam Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Finally, Steam achievements for MONSTERS OF KANJI are available. They unlock retroactive as soon as you go to the game's world map.

Some other small change that comes with this update:
The game won't start in Fullscreen anymore. To enter Fullscreen use F4.

Good luck getting all those achievements and thank you for playing! :)
